title: Actions related to transmission of RRCReconfigurationSidelink message

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationSidelink
entities.description: RRC message used to reconfigure sidelink parameters and bearers for NR sidelink communication.

entities.name: SLRB-PC5-ConfigIndex
entities.description: Information element identifying a sidelink DRB configuration index for release in slrb-ConfigToReleaseList.

entities.name: SLRB-Config
entities.description: Information element containing configuration for sidelink DRB establishment or modification in slrb-ConfigToAddModList.

entities.name: sl-MeasConfig
entities.description: Information element for sidelink measurement configuration, set based on UE state and stored configuration.

entities.name: T400
entities.description: Timer started for the destination associated with a sidelink DRB upon transmission of RRCReconfigurationSidelink.

entities.name: sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5
entities.description: Information element for sidelink DRX configuration for unicast, set based on UE state and resource allocation mode.

entities.name: SL-RLC-ChannelConfig-PC5
entities.description: Information element for PC5 Relay RLC channel configuration, included in release or add/modify lists.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: UE RRC state where the UE has an active connection with the network.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: UE RRC state where the UE is not actively connected to the network.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: UE RRC state where the UE is inactive but retains some connection context.

entities.name: Resource allocation mode 1
entities.description: Condition where UE performs sidelink operation with network-scheduled resource allocation.

entities.name: Submit to lower layers
entities.description: Action where the UE submits the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message to lower layers for transmission.

relations.description: RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes SLRB-PC5-ConfigIndex in slrb-ConfigToReleaseList for sidelink DRB release.
RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes SLRB-Config in slrb-ConfigToAddModList for sidelink DRB establishment/modification.
RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes sl-MeasConfig set based on UE state and stored configuration.
Transmission of RRCReconfigurationSidelink starts timer T400 for the destination associated with the sidelink DRB.
RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5 set based on UE state and resource allocation mode.
RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes SL-RLC-ChannelConfig-PC5 in release or add/modify lists for PC5 Relay RLC channels.
Setting sl-MeasConfig requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED to use stored NR sidelink measurement configuration.
Setting sl-MeasConfig requires UE to be in RRC_IDLE to use configuration from SIB12.
Setting sl-MeasConfig requires UE to be in RRC_INACTIVE to use configuration from SIB12.
Setting sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5 is guarded by the condition that UE is performing sidelink operation with resource allocation mode 1.
Transmission of RRCReconfigurationSidelink establishes the property of submitting the message to lower layers.
